comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a robot-gripper motion limit; PR-1849 gauges seven machined blocks and sorts them by dimensional tolerance.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial tool seating and countertorque; PR-1849 requires repeated alignment with GO and NO-GO gaps, released gauge checks and sorting.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a retained target angle and functional cycles; PR-1849 requires valid ordered gauge checks and correct final tray classification, with escapes penalized.
comparison.reason: Dimensional inspection and classification do not test threaded stop locking or retention under cycling; all material rubric details are present.
